agents.name: craft
rules: Use full descriptive identifiers in C++/Python/JS. Reject opaque abbreviations without domain meaning; preserve required ABI/protocol/register names. JS/TS conventions apply only to JS/TS. For changed UI strings/layout apply localization and viewport/DPI guidance only where relevant. Repeated SDK control/test cycles must reuse the existing scenario and serve/in-process dispatcher; spawning a fresh Python/CLI per step without measured necessity is a workflow regression. Require measured per-operation and full-cycle timings, preserved session/PID creation guards, source/workspace invalidation and no timeout replay. Verify the existing fast path before creating replacement infrastructure. Process/hooks/API evidence is mandatory whenever it can establish a fact. Reject screenshot-based checking of game phase, readiness, command outcomes, model counts, module state or calculations. Missing telemetry, errors and timeouts require telemetry repair, not screenshot fallback. Reject autonomous game screenshots, including UI checks. Require an explicit owner request for the actual image or visual comparison before capture. Cells, grid dimensions, positions, window visibility/bounds, selection and controls require process/hooks/API/Win32 evidence. Require each verification plan to name its property and programmatic oracle; missing diagnostics must be repaired. Generic test/fix/show-window requests do not authorize image-based state checking. Review evidence is noncompliant when screenshots replace available programmatic oracles, even if the numeric result is correct. Require reuse of the last verified scenario rather than rebuilding existing mechanisms.
Load the actual configured skill guides before reviewing; resolve Codex aliases through the marketplace links in AGENTS.md. Do not claim a skill was applied if its guide was unavailable.

Every new feature must be human-usable without AI: clear entry point/help/defaults/progress/actionable failures and a reproducible human workflow. Do not accept a chain of internal Python/PowerShell/RPC commands as the primary user interface, or document an unimplemented friendly command as available.

Human usability includes README/help/documentation/descriptions/examples/messages: explain purpose, starting steps, expected results and recovery for the intended reader, define terms, and do not require AI to fill missing steps or decode internal jargon.

Human docs/help/descriptions must not expose numerical memory addresses, pointer/structure byte offsets or address-derived disassembler labels. Require meaningful function/event/type symbols with purpose explained; numeric bindings stay in source/private evidence. Preserve original technical records privately and retain dated conclusions when correcting old docs. Treat an address-only explanation as a documentation finding.

The knowledge website is the canonical home of living manuals, references and explanations. Repository README/AGENTS must link there; reject parallel maintained documentation copies. Preserve dated/private evidence separately; do not publish raw memory addresses or personal working logs.

Every new or changed article requires five separate independent critic identities, one for each lens: newcomer clarity, technical accuracy, reproducibility, structure/navigation, terminology/translation. Use the marketplace critique method, exact locations, failure modes, severity and evidence; freeze each round, merge by location, fix confirmed substantial defects, record content hashes and finding dispositions, at most three rounds. Do not count author self-review or one generalist as five critics.

Before new tools/infrastructure/dependencies inspect the canonical technology inventory and existing code/manifests. Reject duplicate parallel infrastructure without a concrete gap. Dependency additions/upgrades/removals and changes to purpose or usage location require a canonical inventory update in the same change, with purpose, usage location, version source and matching code/manifests. Inspect installed libraries, modules and language facilities before adding another technology; require a concrete unmet need. Distinguish researched candidates from installed dependencies.

Require actual prior-project evidence, pinned homm5-editor topic search, other external research, hypothesis/decision, targeted verification and applicability limits. Missing research or invented evidence blocks acceptance; reuse matching evidence. Verify the evidence rather than JSON presence. Root workshop acceptance requires its current-diff research gate.

SDK adapter axiom: plugin behavior must remain independent of developer SDK imports. Only integration adapters translate the common lifecycle/event/state contract. Distinguish the shared player loader/runtime from xkit developer tools and plugin adapters. Preserve the complete prior feature set during migration; reject developer-tool dependencies in player packages and SDK coupling spread through plugin behavior. Final player independence is a required acceptance boundary: changing an adapter, loader or packaging requires inspecting actual release installation paths, DLL exports/imports and declared dependencies, plus ordinary final-package startup without installed xkit, Python/Node, supervisor, source checkout or workshop paths. SDK/HMR success alone does not prove player readiness; preserve all prior mod behavior and UI. Developer checks never authorize claiming final standalone acceptance. Mandatory architecture boundary: the adapter depends on the public runtime contract and mod behavior; mod algorithms/UI must not depend on the adapter, SDK internal types or resident-buffer layouts, supervisor commands, workshop paths or HMR mechanics. Mod-specific behavior must not move into the shared runtime. Treat any implementation leakage or migration-driven rewrite/loss of working behavior as a blocking architecture finding. Static package checks do not prove source-layer separation or behavioral parity. Required detailed contract: https://xaaalera.github.io/heroes5-knowledge/modding/native-projects/#architecture-contract . Review its layer responsibilities, two operating modes, state/cleanup ownership and migration-completion table; report current conformance separately from normative requirements.
